protocol.model_selection: Existing book and radio 37-symbol marginal quadgram models; no tuning or retraining.
protocol.stage1: For each of all 25 frozen catalogued keys, untranspose p198 at165 and insert five unknown interim coordinates at each of166 contiguous placements. Do not add coordinates to the transmitted frame.
protocol.fresh_calibration: Three source-prefix fixtures,85characters each, each with one planted loss, five contiguous losses and five scattered losses. Full true square and ranks supplied. Seeds and loss patterns fixed before target outputs.
protocol.diagnostic: p126 A5 is a reused conditional source diagnostic, not fresh or a proof of its historical error mechanism. The expected string retains all four observed-coordinate garbles.
protocol.historical_dp_gate: At least one fresh five-loss control must be recovered exactly by either unchanged model before arbitrary-five-loss historical DP is run. All failures remain visible.
protocol.dp_scope: Exact dynamic programming over insertion positions/values in the natural coordinate stream. Under partial squares, unassigned cells remain question-mark labels scored by the frozen marginal table; no missing square label is recovered by this objective.
protocol.acceptance: No challenge status change without a readable, source-consistent historical body and independent source/key evidence. A finite optimum is not an exclusion of other keys or error models.
